title: 第一卷 第7章 顶级弓材黄麂第一卷 第8章 山中猎人
content_zh:
青山城外，农田与山脉接壤处。
李乘风持弓背箭，腰间提着长刀和饭团水葫芦，在守卫新奇的目光中，沿着山道踏步走到山林里。
他选了一条和昨天不同的山路，再次翻过五座山，终于离开了处在外围的私人山林。
“这些买了山林的地主什么都不干，在山里养些禽畜，捡些树枝都是一大笔财源，哪用得着像我一样还得进山狩猎。”
过了这有主的山脉，李乘风回头看了看那最外围山林，神色羡慕，但是这种事情他也只有羡慕的份，摇着脑袋将心思压下，开始小心地向更深处的山里钻去。
靠近这些私人山林的山脉虽然安全，但是也会被守山人闲着没事搜刮捕猎一番，根本没什么猎物。
想捕捉到猎物，还得向更深处走走看。
“只要不是太深入，就没什么问题。”
李乘风看着里面连绵不绝的山脉，心中很清醒，那些虎豹豺狼不是傻子，都会远离人类活动的区域，所以只要不是太深入都不会有什么问题。
反而一些弱小一些的中小体型素食动物，为了躲避这些凶猛动物的吞食，反而会转过来走到更外围。
前面五座山前，就有不少猎物，只不过李乘风现在身体还不算特别强壮，没有特别的深入山林，还不确定一个具体的安全范围。
“呼~”
这么在山脉树林里行走，又翻过一座山后，李乘风呼了口气，正想喝口水歇歇，忽然眼神一动，在不远处发现了一只背对着他吃草的兔子。
他眼神动了动，顿时轻手拉开弓箭，瞄准，手中一松。
“嗖~”
竹箭飞射，径直奔向兔子身体，正在吃草的兔子还没来得及抬头箭矢就穿过它的身体直接将它钉在了地上。
【技能：箭术】
【等级：精通（280）】
【效果：稳定增加30%；准度增加20%】
“歘~”

眼前信息飘过，心中涌现一丝用弓感悟，李乘风急忙跑过去喜滋滋地将射在地上的肥兔子捡起来。
先用专门带的葫芦把兔子血倒进去，等到流干了把葫芦嘴一塞，再将兔子尸体装在随身的布袋里，满脸笑容。
“第一个猎物，保底有了。”
李乘风心中愉悦，把布袋子在腰间系好，随后小心地环绕了一周，取出装水的葫芦喝了一口，坐在地上歇了歇。
等到体力恢复了一些，又抽出一根竹箭，继续钻向前方山林。
“…………”
山里的猎物其实并不好找。
真正成熟的猎人，都是有一个专门的狩猎台，每天在狩猎台上守株待兔，等猎物走到自己待的范围再射。
平日里再加上各种陷阱帮助，才能保证收益。
但李乘风是新手，对山里还没摸熟，自然没办法像这样干，只能拿着弓四处寻找，同时也在熟悉，记忆山林。
幸好的是，山里的竹子也不少，李乘风没见到有能当竹箭的竹子，就会把背上的竹箭射出一些，再重新制作竹箭。
如此，等到他清空第二捆箭矢，第三捆竹箭也只剩下一半的时候……
“吱~”
层压竹弓拉满，李乘风眼神冷静地瞄准前方地面上遇到的第二只肥硕野兔，手中箭矢一松。
“嗖~”
竹箭急射而出，一箭穿过兔子身体。
content_en:
Outside Qingshan City, where farmland meets the mountains.
Li Chengfeng held an arrow on his back, a long knife and a rice ball and water hyacinth at his waist. Under the curious eyes of the guards, he walked along the mountain path into the forest.
He chose a different mountain road from yesterday, climbed over five mountains again, and finally left the private forest on the outskirts.
"These landowners who bought the mountains and forests do nothing. Raising some livestock and picking up some branches in the mountains are a huge source of wealth. There is no need for them to go into the mountains to hunt like me."
After passing the owned mountain range, Li Chengfeng looked back at the outermost mountains and forests with an expression of envy. However, he could only be envious of this kind of thing. He shook his head to suppress his thoughts and began to carefully drill deeper into the mountains.
Although the mountains close to these private forests are safe, they will be searched and hunted by the mountain guards when they have nothing to do, and there is no prey at all.
If you want to catch prey, you have to go deeper.
"As long as it doesn't go too deep, it's fine."
Li Chengfeng looked at the endless mountains inside and felt very clear in his heart. Those tigers, leopards and jackals were not fools and would stay away from human activities, so as long as they didn't go too deep, there wouldn't be any problem.
On the contrary, some weaker small and medium-sized vegetarian animals will turn around and walk to the outside in order to avoid being devoured by these ferocious animals.
There are a lot of prey in front of the five mountains in front, but Li Chengfeng is not particularly strong yet, and has not gone deep into the mountains and forests, so he is not yet sure of a specific safety range.
"Huh~"
After walking in the mountains and woods and climbing over another mountain, Li Chengfeng exhaled and was about to take a drink of water to rest. Suddenly his eyes moved and he spotted a rabbit grazing with its back to him not far away.
His eyes moved, and he immediately drew the bow and arrow lightly, took aim, and let go.
"Whoosh~"
The bamboo arrow flew straight towards the rabbit's body. Before the grazing rabbit had time to raise its head, the arrow passed through its body and pinned it to the ground.
[Skill: Archery]
[Level: Mastery (280)]
[Effect: stability increased by 30%; accuracy increased by 20%]
"歘~"
As the information passed before his eyes, and a hint of bow-wielding inspiration emerged in his heart, Li Chengfeng hurried over and happily picked up the fat rabbit that had fallen to the ground.
First, he poured the rabbit's blood into the gourd he brought with him. When it was drained, he stuffed the mouth of the gourd, and then he put the rabbit's body in the cloth bag he brought with him, with a smile on his face.
"The first prey is guaranteed."
Li Chengfeng felt happy and tied the cloth bag around his waist, then carefully circled it, took out the gourd filled with water, took a sip, and sat on the ground to rest.
After he regained some strength, he took out another bamboo arrow and continued to drill into the forest ahead.
"…………"
Prey in the mountains is actually not easy to find.
A truly mature hunter has a special hunting platform where he waits for prey every day until the prey reaches his range before shooting.
Only with the help of various traps on weekdays can the profits be guaranteed.
But Li Chengfeng was a novice and was not familiar with the mountains. Naturally, he couldn't do it like this. He could only search around with a bow, and at the same time he was familiar with and memorized the mountains and forests.
Fortunately, there are a lot of bamboos in the mountains. If Li Chengfeng didn't see any bamboo that could be used as bamboo arrows, he would shoot some of the bamboo arrows on his back and make new bamboo arrows.
In this way, when he emptied the second bundle of arrows and only half of the third bundle of bamboo arrows remained...
"Squeak~"
With his laminated bamboo bow fully drawn, Li Chengfeng aimed calmly at the second plump hare he encountered on the ground in front of him, and the arrow loosened in his hand.
"Whoosh~"
The bamboo arrow shot out quickly and penetrated the rabbit's body.
